entities.name: Barnabas R. Halem ’Imana
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Barnabas Rugwizangonga Halem ’Imana, was a Ugandan Roman Catholic priest who served as Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Kabale from 1969 until 1994.
